node.name: Handshake and request path
node.responsibility: Runs the handshake once, then is the one path every call takes: serialize, send, decode, adopt
node.description: createCodexSession: initialize, write initialized, read the config requirements and the config as the child's working directory sees it (workingDirectory: the coordinator's own directory, which is no checkout), prove storage, and advance the explicit session phase; notifications are buffered until the session is ready. requestDecoded serializes the parameters, decodes them against the protocol, sends them on the transport, checks the epoch, decodes the answer and adopts its identities, reporting any failure of a mutation as a delivery outcome.

runs.text: Runs the handshake once, then is the one path

node.name: Prove isolated storage
node.description: Compares handshake storage facts with canonical, non-symlinked CODEX_HOME, SQLite, and config paths before the session becomes usable.

node.name: Gate protocol operations
node.description: Implements the reviewed login, thread, turn, queue, timeline, and realtime methods as reads or mutations of the request path, behind login-capable and thread-capable gates.

node.name: Serialize request identities
node.description: Validates every identity-bearing request field against the current child authority and serializes only issued identities for the wire.

node.name: Response contracts
node.responsibility: Which identity kinds each method's result carries, derived from the protocol schemas
node.description: Defines the response shapes of the session's methods from the codex-protocol schemas and SESSION_PROTOCOL_METHODS, the identity kinds each result contains, which the adoption step collects.

runs.text: Which identity kinds each method's result carries,

node.name: Adopt response identities
node.description: Collects all raw identities in a decoded response, adopts them in one authority transaction, and overlays their trusted brands.

node.name: Answer reverse requests
node.description: Routes current-time requests for owned threads and explicitly refuses unsupported token refresh and attestation requests.

node.name: Classify request failures
node.description: Distinguishes invalid inputs and failures that were not delivered from mutations whose remote outcome is unknown and requires inspection.
